### Overview & role

`cupertino_native_better` (internally still `package:cupertino_native_better/...`) is the **iOS native tier** of the host app. On iOS 26+ and macOS 26+ it renders Apple's real Liquid Glass through Swift/UIKit (iOS) and AppKit (macOS) `UiKitView`/`AppKitView` platform views; on older Apple OSes it falls back to `Cupertino`; on Android/web it falls back to Material. It is the concrete implementation beneath `appbox_kit`'s `Kit*` ports — the host almost never imports `cupertino_native_better` directly; `appbox_kit` does, and re-exports nothing.

The package ships three layers fused into one `path` dep: a federated Flutter plugin (Dart platform interface + method channel + Swift/SPM native), a Dart widget library of `CN*` widgets that own the build-time platform branch, and an iOS-26-only native tab-bar takeover (`CNTabBarNative`) that bypasses the widget tree and presents a real `UITabBarController`.

### Glossary

<Table
  id="cn-glossary"
  columns={["Term", "Meaning"]}
  rows={[
    ["CN*", "Naming prefix for every public Dart widget/class in this package: CNButton, CNIcon, CNTabBar, CNSlider, CNSwitch, CNPopupMenuButton, CNSegmentedControl, CNGlassButtonGroup, CNBottomSheet, CNFloatingIsland, CNSearchBar, CNToast, CNGlassCard, CNSplitButton, etc."],
    ["Liquid Glass", "Apple's design language introduced in iOS 26 / macOS 26 — translucent, refractive surfaces rendered natively by UIKit/AppKit. This package surfaces it via UiKitView/AppKitView platform views, not Dart paint."],
    ["UiKitView / AppKitView", "Flutter platform-view embedders. iOS 26+ CN widgets become a UiKitView backed by a Swift factory; macOS 26+ by an AppKitView + NSView factory. Older OSes use a pure Dart Cupertino widget instead — same Dart API."],
    ["CNTabBarRouteObserver", "A NavigatorObserver exported from components/tab_bar.dart. Must be registered on the root navigator so CN widgets learn when sheets/modals/popups cover them and hide/clip their platform views to stop Liquid Glass halos bleeding through."],
    ["PlatformVersion", "Dart-side version detector (utils/version_detector.dart) that parses Platform.operatingSystemVersion — NOT a method channel — so release builds return correct iOS/macOS versions. Auto-initializes on first access."],
    ["PlatformViewGuard", "Debug-only 500 ms gate that delays platform-view creation until the engine has purged stale registrations after a hot restart. No-op in release mode."],
    ["ModalHideMixin", "Mixin used by CNButton/CNSlider/CNSwitch/etc. that listens to CNTabBarRouteObserver and self-destroys its platform view while a sheet/popup is above it."],
    ["CNTabBarNative", "iOS-26-only native tab-bar TAKEOVER (a real UITabBarController). NOT a Flutter Widget — invoked via static CNTabBarNative.enable(...). Drives its own Flutter content per tab."],
    ["CupertinoNativeBetter", "Top-level facade class for low-level platform interactions. Most callers never touch it; use the CN* widgets directly."],
  ]}
/>

### Architecture

The package is a **federated Flutter plugin** plus a Dart widget library. Each widget does a build-time branch:

- iOS 26+ / macOS 26+ → embed a `UiKitView`/`AppKitView` whose native side is built by a Swift `*Factory` (registered by `CupertinoNativePlugin`) and rendered by SwiftUI/UIKit/AppKit.
- Older Apple (iOS < 26, macOS < 26) → emit the equivalent `Cupertino` widget.
- Android / web → emit the Material equivalent.

Native code is shipped via Swift Package Manager (`ios/cupertino_native_better/Package.swift`, `macos/cupertino_native_better/Package.swift`), with two `.podspec` files per platform as a CocoaPods fallback. The iOS SPM target depends on `SVGKit ~> 3.0` for SVG image rendering. Per-instance method channels (`CupertinoNativeXxx_$id`, `CNGlassCard_$id`, `CNSearchBar_$id`, etc.) wire Dart state to each platform view; the takeover tab bar has its own `cn_native_tab_bar` channel; a legacy facade channel exposes `getPlatformVersion` for debugging.

### Usage playbook

<AnnotatedCode
  id="cn-usage-app"
  filename="host_app/lib/main.dart"
  language="dart"
  code={"import 'package:flutter/material.dart';\nimport 'package:cupertino_native_better/cupertino_native_better.dart';\n\nvoid main() => runApp(const MyApp());\n\nclass MyApp extends StatelessWidget {\n  const MyApp({super.key});\n  @override\n  Widget build(BuildContext context) {\n    return MaterialApp(\n      // REQUIRED: register the route observer on the root navigator.\n      navigatorObservers: [CNTabBarRouteObserver()],\n      home: const Home(),\n    );\n  }\n}\n\nclass Home extends StatefulWidget {\n  const Home({super.key});\n  @override\n  State<Home> createState() => _HomeState();\n}\n\nclass _HomeState extends State<Home> {\n  final _slider = CNSliderController(value: 0.4);\n  final _switch = CNSwitchController(value: true);\n\n  @override\n  Widget build(BuildContext context) {\n    return Scaffold(\n      body: Center(\n        child: Column(\n          mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,\n          children: [\n            CNButton(\n              onPressed: () {},\n              child: const Text('Push'),\n              config: const CNButtonConfig(style: CNButtonStyle.glass),\n            ),\n            const SizedBox(height: 16),\n            CNSlider(controller: _slider, min: 0, max: 100),\n            const SizedBox(height: 16),\n            CNSwitch(controller: _switch),\n            const SizedBox(height: 16),\n            LiquidGlassContainer(\n              child: const Padding(\n                padding: EdgeInsets.all(16),\n                child: Text('Liquid Glass surface'),\n              ),\n            ),\n          ],\n        ),\n      ),\n    );\n  }\n}\n"}
  annotations={[
    { lines: "9", label: "Observer", note: "Without CNTabBarRouteObserver on the root navigator, glass halos bleed through sheets and popups." },
    { lines: "31", label: "Glass", note: "style: CNButtonStyle.glass picks Liquid Glass on iOS 26+; falls back to Cupertino on older Apple, Material elsewhere." },
  ]}

### Wiring

<Callout id="cn-wiring-callout" tone="warning">

**Hosts almost never declare this package as a direct dep.** It is a `path:` dependency of `appbox_kit` (`path: ../cupertino_native_better`); `appbox_kit` is the only intended consumer. Importing `cupertino_native_better` directly from a host app is fine for one-off native surfaces, but the Kit* ports are the supported surface. **iOS deployment target: 15.0** (set in `ios/cupertino_native_better/Package.swift`). **macOS deployment target: 11.0**. Swift tools version **5.9**. Native code is consumed via Swift Package Manager (with `.podspec` fallbacks).

</Callout>

The four local patches held in this vendored fork:

<AnnotatedCode
  id="cn-patch1"
  filename="pubspec.yaml (patch #1)"
  language="yaml"
  code={"dependencies:\n  flutter:\n    sdk: flutter\n  # LOCAL PATCH: upstream uses CupertinoIcons.* glyphs (toast.dart) without\n  # depending on the cupertino_icons font package, so every toast icon\n  # renders as a \"?\" tofu box in apps that don't happen to pull it in\n  # themselves (observed on the iOS 26.5 sim). Declaring it here bundles\n  # the icon font.\n  cupertino_icons: ^1.0.8\n  plugin_platform_interface: ^2.0.2"}
  annotations={[{ lines: "8", label: "Patch #1", note: "Revert when upstream accepts the dependency; this is a no-op patch for apps that already pull cupertino_icons, and additive for everyone else." }]}
/>

<AnnotatedCode
  id="cn-patch2"
  filename="appbox_kit/pubspec.yaml (records patch #2)"
  language="yaml"
  code={"  # Vendored at ../cupertino_native_better: upstream 1.5.2 + local fix to the\n  # iOS tab-bar platform view (refresh no longer clobbers native selection /\n  # setSelectedIndex race — the \"Search tab mixed state\" ticket). Path dep\n  # so the patch survives `pub cache repair`; drop back to hosted once\n  # upstreamed.\n  cupertino_native_better:\n    path: ../cupertino_native_better"}
  annotations={[{ lines: "5-6", label: "Path dep", note: "Path dep (not hosted) so the local fix survives `pub cache repair`. Patch #2 lives in the Swift tab-bar factory on the iOS side and pairs with CNTabBarRouteObserver/CNTabBar logic in components/tab_bar.dart." }]}
/>

<AnnotatedCode
  id="cn-patch3"
  filename="lib/components/button.dart (patch #3)"
  language="dart"
  code={"    // LOCAL PATCH #3: pin the width only for icon-ONLY buttons — the same\n    // test the native path's LayoutBuilder uses. Upstream keyed on\n    // widget.isIcon, which is also true when a label is present, so an\n    // icon+label button was squashed into a defaultHeight-wide (44pt) box\n    // and its label overflowed. Icon+label buttons must size to content.\n    // Revert when upstreamed.\n    final buttonWidth = isIconOnlyButton\n        ? (widget.config.width ?? calculatedSize ?? defaultHeight)\n        : null;"}
  annotations={[{ lines: "7-9", label: "Patch #3", note: "Applied in BOTH fallback tiers (_buildCupertinoFallback + _buildMaterialFallback); isIconOnlyButton = widget.isIcon && widget.label == null, mirroring the native path. Regression test: test/fallback_tier_test.dart (icon+label not width-pinned; icon-only stays 44pt square). Revert when upstreamed." }]}
/>

<AnnotatedCode
  id="cn-patch4"
  filename="lib/components/icon.dart (patch #4)"
  language="dart"
  code={"    // Widget SELECTION gates on defaultTargetPlatform (honors\n    // debugDefaultTargetPlatformOverride) + the package's flutter-test\n    // probe — never dart:io Platform, which reflects the test HOST and\n    // made CNIcon build an AppKitView headless (MissingPluginException).\n    final shouldUseNative =\n        !kIsWeb &&\n        !PlatformViewGuard.isTestEnvironment &&\n        (defaultTargetPlatform == TargetPlatform.iOS ||\n            defaultTargetPlatform == TargetPlatform.macOS);"}
  annotations={[{ lines: "5-9", label: "Patch #4", note: "Was PlatformVersion.supportsSFSymbols (dart:io Platform.isIOS || Platform.isMacOS — TRUE on a macOS test host). Real iOS/macOS selection unchanged. PlatformViewGuard.isTestEnvironment was exposed (public getter) for this gate. Regression test: test/fallback_tier_test.dart (no platform view under android OR iOS override). Revert when upstreamed." }]}
/>

<Callout id="cn-observer-callout" tone="warning">

**`CNTabBarRouteObserver()` must be on the root navigator.** On `MaterialApp` use `navigatorObservers:`; on `CupertinoApp` likewise; on `GoRouter` use `observers:` on the router config. Without it, `anyModalDepth` never advances and Liquid Glass halos bleed through sheets/modals/popups. For non-route overlays (`Scaffold.showBottomSheet`, persistent bottom sheets) you must also call `CNTabBarRouteObserver.markAnyModalActive()` on open and `markAnyModalInactive()` on close — the observer can only see route-based modals.

</Callout>

### Gotchas

<Callout id="cn-gotcha-patches" tone="warning">

**Four local patches — revert when upstreamed.** Patch #1 (`cupertino_icons: ^1.0.8` in this package's `pubspec.yaml`) fixes "?" tofu toast icons. Patch #2 (in the Swift tab-bar factory + `components/tab_bar.dart`) fixes the iOS tab-bar platform-view refresh race that corrupted the search tab's selection ("Search tab mixed state"). Patch #3 (`components/button.dart`, both fallback tiers) pins the fallback button's width only for icon-ONLY buttons — icon+label buttons were squashed to a 44pt-wide box. Patch #4 (`components/icon.dart` + a public `PlatformViewGuard.isTestEnvironment` getter) gates `CNIcon`'s native tier on `defaultTargetPlatform` instead of dart:io `Platform`, so `flutter test` on a macOS host no longer builds an `AppKitView` headless (`MissingPluginException`). All are recorded in code comments (`LOCAL PATCH #n`); the path dep on `appbox_kit` ensures they survive `pub cache repair`. When upstream ships them, drop back to hosted.

</Callout>

<Callout id="cn-gotcha-svgkit" tone="warning">

**SVGKit adds binary weight on iOS.** The iOS SPM target depends on `SVGKit ~> 3.0`. If you don't use SVG image assets via `CNImageAsset`, you still pay the binary cost — this is upstream behavior, not a local choice.

</Callout>

<Callout id="cn-gotcha-native-tabbar" tone="warning">

**`CNTabBarNative` is iOS-26-only AND not a Flutter Widget.** It's a class with static `enable()/disable()` methods that present a real `UITabBarController`. Two consequences: (a) on iOS < 26 / macOS / Android / web, `enable()` is a no-op — do not gate it from Dart; (b) do NOT drive an `IndexedStack` from `onTabSelected`. The native bar IS the source of truth for selection; mirroring it into a Flutter IndexedStack creates a double-source-of-truth race (the same class of bug patch #2 fixed).

</Callout>

<Callout id="cn-gotcha-container-in-list" tone="warning">

**`LiquidGlassContainer` is a UiKitView.** Don't put it (or `CNButton`, `CNSlider`, `CNSwitch`, etc.) inside a `ListView.builder` / `GridView` / any virtualizing list. Each cell creates a platform view, which is expensive to mount and recycle. Use the Dart fallback (`Cupertino`/`Material`) for cells, or hoist the glass surface above the list.

</Callout>

<Callout id="cn-gotcha-macos-spm" tone="info">

**macOS support is real, not just a `topics` claim.** `pubspec.yaml` declares `macos: pluginClass: CupertinoNativePlugin` and the macOS SPM package at `macos/cupertino_native_better/Package.swift` ships a full Swift target (AppKit NSView factories for button, slider, switch, segmented control, popup menu, tab bar, glass container). The old `macos/Classes/` Cocoapods convention is replaced by SPM sources under `macos/cupertino_native_better/Sources/`. The macOS deployment target is 11.0; Liquid Glass surfaces light up on macOS 26+.

</Callout>

### Decisions / ADRs

<Callout id="cn-decisions-none" tone="info">

No formal ADRs in this package. Four upstream-pending decisions are documented in code comments as the local-patch rationale (patches #1–#4). When upstreaming, capture the iOS-26-only / non-Widget nature of `CNTabBarNative` and the `CNTabBarRouteObserver`-must-be-on-root-navigator contract in upstream docs.

</Callout>
